ui.allert_error_occurred: An error occurred, please report it to the developer
ui.auto_forward_time_description: Seconds to wait before auto-advancing. When Text Speed is on, waits for the typewriter to finish first.
ui.continue_auto_exit_save_tooltip: Last time you exited without saving. You can continue from where you left off.
ui.history_hotkey_description: Open settings directly on the history list.
ui.quick_load_hotkey_alternative_descriptio: Load the latest save slot with Ctrl+L.
ui.primary_color_description: Choose the primary color for the theme.
ui.quick_save_hotkey_alternative_descriptio: Save the current progress with Ctrl+S.
ui.you_sure_to_overwrite_save: You are about to overwrite this save. This action cannot be undone.
ui.hotkeys_menu_shortcut_description: Open settings directly on the controls list.
ui.settings_toggle_hotkey_description: Open or close the settings menu.
ui.name: Name
ui.diagnostics_webgl2_missing_message: This game requires WebGL2. Please update your browser, operating system, or GPU drivers.
ui.diagnostics_native_unavailable: Not available — running in a standard browser.
ui.diagnostics_steam_overlay_hint: Best-effort detection only; not reliable in a standard browser.
ui.diagnostics_hotkey_description: Open settings directly on the diagnostics page.
ui.quick_actions_open_description: Press Tab to open or close the quick actions wheel.
ui.skip_hold_description: Hold Enter to enable skip mode.
ui.skip_hold_space_description: Hold Space to enable skip mode.
ui.skip_release_description: Release Enter to disable skip mode and continue.
ui.skip_release_space_description: Release Space to disable skip mode and continue.
ui.solid_color_description: Choose the solid color for the theme. It can be black or white and will be contrasting with the primary color. So if the primary color is dark, the solid color will be white, and a the other way around.
ui.quit_confirm: Are you sure you want to quit the game?
ui.choice_navigation_description: Use ↑ / ↓ to select an choice, then Enter to run it.
ui.text_speed_description: Choose the speed of the typewriter effect. If is set to 0 ( off ) the text will appear instantly.
ui.text_size_description: Adjust the font size of the entire interface.
ui.theme_mode_description: Choose between light, dark, or system theme mode.
ui.you_sure_to_delete_save: Are you sure you want to delete this save file?
ui.you_sure_to_load_save: Are you sure you want to load this save file?
ui.you_sure_to_return_main_menu: Are you sure you want to return to the main menu? All unsaved progress will be lost.
ui.master_volume_description: Controls the overall audio level for the game. Use this to raise or lower all sounds at once.
ui.bgm_volume_description: Sets the volume for background music tracks only.
ui.sfx_volume_description: Sets the volume for sound effects such as UI clicks and in-game actions.
ui.language_description: Choose the display language. When the language matches your browser setting, it is marked as "(system)".
ui.offline_description: The game is paused until a stable connection is available again.
ui.offline_hint: Check your network and try again.
